game: RM3E01 (Metroid Prime 3: Corruption, USA, disc 0, rev 0)
request: Keyboard mode could not fire the grapple lasso ('Cast Nunchuk forward'); also a held modifier to slow the twist/push motions.
root_cause: The synthesized Nunchuk thrust (0.18 s flick on raw Y, the pointing axis) was not what the game's motion analyser measures. The lasso commands read gesture table A entry 10, which is the Nunchuk bit 0x40000: the low-passed Nunchuk Z accelerometer must swing by more than 0.45 * 512 raw units within the 15 ring entries before the current one.

limits: The model follows the analyser as decompiled; the HLE delivers one WPAD sample per retrace (60 Hz), so the game's filter runs at that rate here.
